choices.why: A light birch table for four, 125 cm wide, fits the open floor beside the kitchenette and matches the nordic, simple look the user asked for.
Four matte black bentwood bistro chairs, light and open, give the requested crisp black contrast against the pale birch table and the white walls.
A simple white bell pendant blends with the white ceiling and walls and suits a light wood table with black chairs.
A light natural wood sideboard, 140 cm wide and 45 cm deep, sits neatly against the long white wall and echoes the blonde tones of the table and the kitchen wood.

answer.why: Pale birch and light wood repeat the light wood of the kitchenette cabinets, while the black chairs add a graphic Scandinavian contrast. The white pendant keeps the white room airy and simple.
